## Issue tracker

SDD specs and tickets live in numbered `.scratch/<feature-id>-<feature-slug>/` workspaces. See `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` and `docs/agents/ticket-tracker.md` for their conventions.

## Domain docs

This is a multi-context repo; use `GLOSSARY-MAP.md` to find the relevant context glossary and consult `docs/adr/` for cross-context decisions. See `docs/agents/domain.md`.

## Project Constitution

Read and follow `docs/agents/constitution.md` when planning or changing project files. If it conflicts with repository-wide instructions or architectural decisions, report the conflict rather than silently overriding them.

## Project Tooling

Run project commands with pnpm. Before running commands, read [Project tooling](../docs/agents/tooling.md) for available commands and usage.
